title: Full State Capture
description: Full State Capture is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Captures every panel, node, and setting into one snapshot object. The capture walks the workspace tree and serializes each component's state with its schema version. It takes workspace tree and produces snapshot object. Tunable parameters: schema v1. Guarantee: capture never omits open panels.

fields.mechanism: The capture walks the workspace tree and serializes each component's state with its schema version.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Delta Snapshots
description: Delta Snapshots is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Stores only what changed since the last snapshot to keep files small. A diff against the previous snapshot is computed; unchanged subtrees are referenced, not copied. It takes previous snapshot and produces delta file. Tunable parameters: reference by hash. Guarantee: deltas always apply cleanly in order.

fields.mechanism: A diff against the previous snapshot is computed; unchanged subtrees are referenced, not copied.
fields.guarantees: deltas always apply cleanly in order

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Portable File Format
description: Portable File Format is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Writes snapshots as a single self-describing .jws file. The file bundles the snapshot JSON, a manifest, and a checksum in a zip container. It takes snapshot object and produces .jws file. Tunable parameters: zip + JSON. Guarantee: the checksum always verifies on open.

fields.mechanism: The file bundles the snapshot JSON, a manifest, and a checksum in a zip container.
fields.guarantees: the checksum always verifies on open

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Cross-Device Restore
description: Cross-Device Restore is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Restores a snapshot on a different device with layout adaptation. On restore, panel sizes scale to the new screen and missing fonts fall back gracefully. It takes .jws file and produces restored workspace. Tunable parameters: scale to screen. Guarantee: content is never lost in adaptation.

fields.mechanism: On restore, panel sizes scale to the new screen and missing fonts fall back gracefully.
fields.guarantees: content is never lost in adaptation

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Snapshot Branching
description: Snapshot Branching is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Branches a snapshot so experiments never touch the original. A branch copies the snapshot by reference; writes copy-on-write so branches stay cheap. It takes snapshot and produces branch. Tunable parameters: copy-on-write. Guarantee: the parent snapshot is never mutated.

fields.mechanism: A branch copies the snapshot by reference; writes copy-on-write so branches stay cheap.
fields.guarantees: the parent snapshot is never mutated

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Timed Autosave
description: Timed Autosave is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Autosaves snapshots on a schedule in the background. Every N minutes a delta snapshot is written; failures are retried once, then reported. It takes schedule and produces autosave deltas. Tunable parameters: default 10 min. Guarantee: autosave never blocks the UI.

fields.mechanism: Every N minutes a delta snapshot is written; failures are retried once, then reported.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Snapshot Diff View
description: Snapshot Diff View is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Shows exactly what changed between two snapshots. Both snapshots are diffed field-by-field and the differences render as a readable list. It takes two snapshots and produces diff list. Tunable parameters: field-level. Guarantee: the diff never shows unchanged fields.

fields.mechanism: Both snapshots are diffed field-by-field and the differences render as a readable list.
fields.guarantees: the diff never shows unchanged fields

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Selective Restore
description: Selective Restore is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Restores only chosen parts of a snapshot, e.g. layout but not data. The snapshot tree is filtered by component type before apply; the rest of the live workspace is untouched. It takes snapshot, filter and produces partial restore. Tunable parameters: per-component. Guarantee: unselected parts are never touched.

fields.mechanism: The snapshot tree is filtered by component type before apply; the rest of the live workspace is untouched.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Encrypted Snapshots
description: Encrypted Snapshots is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Encrypts snapshots with a passphrase before they leave the device. AES-256-GCM encrypts the payload; the key is derived from the passphrase with 100k PBKDF2 rounds. It takes passphrase and produces encrypted .jws. Tunable parameters: AES-256-GCM. Guarantee: wrong passphrases always fail loudly.

fields.mechanism: AES-256-GCM encrypts the payload; the key is derived from the passphrase with 100k PBKDF2 rounds.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Snapshot Sharing Links
description: Snapshot Sharing Links is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Shares a snapshot through a link that expires. The snapshot uploads to a temporary store and mints a link with a 7-day TTL. It takes snapshot and produces share link. Tunable parameters: TTL 7 days. Guarantee: expired links always return 404.

fields.mechanism: The snapshot uploads to a temporary store and mints a link with a 7-day TTL.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Version Timeline
description: Version Timeline is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Keeps every snapshot on a visual timeline for time travel. Snapshots append to a timeline with thumbnails; clicking one previews, double-clicking restores. It takes snapshot series and produces timeline. Tunable parameters: thumbnail per snap. Guarantee: the timeline never reorders.

fields.mechanism: Snapshots append to a timeline with thumbnails; clicking one previews, double-clicking restores.

title: Conflict Merge
description: Conflict Merge is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Merges two snapshots edited separately without losing either side. Field-level three-way merge runs against their common ancestor; conflicts are flagged for the user. It takes two snapshots, ancestor and produces merged snapshot. Tunable parameters: 3-way. Guarantee: conflicts are never auto-resolved silently.

fields.mechanism: Field-level three-way merge runs against their common ancestor; conflicts are flagged for the user.

title: Snapshot Search
description: Snapshot Search is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Finds snapshots by content, not just by name or date. Snapshot text is indexed; a query returns the snapshots containing it with context. It takes snapshot store and produces search hits. Tunable parameters: full-text. Guarantee: search never opens snapshots to index them twice.

fields.mechanism: Snapshot text is indexed; a query returns the snapshots containing it with context.
fields.guarantees: search never opens snapshots to index them twice

title: Integrity Verification
description: Integrity Verification is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Verifies a snapshot's checksum before trusting it. The stored checksum is recomputed on open; mismatches refuse to load with a clear error. It takes .jws file and produces verified load. Tunable parameters: SHA-256. Guarantee: tampered files never load.

fields.mechanism: The stored checksum is recomputed on open; mismatches refuse to load with a clear error.

title: Cloud Sync
description: Cloud Sync is a portability ability in the Workspace Snapshot Portability database. Syncs snapshots across the user's devices through their own storage. Snapshots upload on change and download on demand; sync state shows per snapshot. It takes storage backend and produces synced snapshots. Tunable parameters: on change. Guarantee: sync never deletes the newest copy.

fields.mechanism: Snapshots upload on change and download on demand; sync state shows per snapshot.
fields.guarantees: sync never deletes the newest copy
